profile.summary: A volunteer, student-run Medical Reserve Corps unit of emergency medical technicians at UC Berkeley, recognized since 2014 and sponsored by the UC Berkeley Office of Emergency Management. Members provide medical coverage at campus events, train for disaster response, and teach CPR, First Aid and Stop the Bleed classes to the community.
